description: This is a PHP unit test class 'LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest' for testing LDAP anonymous bind functionality in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup routines, configuration manipulations, and multiple test methods for connection scenarios with various LDAP server configurations.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying LDAP anonymous bind functionality, including handling invalid host/port and encryption scenarios.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Static setup method that configures LDAP server settings before any tests are run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Instance setup method that initializes the LDAP server configuration and load data once before each test method.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures LDAP server settings, enables anonymous binding, and loads LDAP fixtures for testing.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests whether an anonymous LDAP connection can be successfully established.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to connect to an invalid LDAP host results in a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to connect with an incorrect port results in a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with SSL encryption on default port, expecting a ContactException if unsuccessful.
